name: Enemy scout team and UAV-operator position
normalized_note: A Russian forward scout team with a UAV operator approaches the power plant from the west through the open coal-storage area immediately south of the main power-plant building. Ducky, Lupin, and Switchblade must avoid detection long enough for Frost, firing from his second overwatch position on the roof of the northern power-plant block, to eliminate the UAV operator and the scout-team leader. The ground team then engages and clears the remaining scouts. This is an NPC support action and does not trigger Frost's playable perspective transition; that later transition occurs from his third overwatch position against the naval-fire observation team.
